column1: - **Email**: Must be valid email format or match phone pattern
- **Password**: Minimum 10 characters (no complexity requirements in code)
- **IDs**: Must be valid UUIDs or Prisma string IDs
- User sessions: 30 days absolute, 7 days idle timeout
- Admin sessions: 12 hours absolute, 30 minutes idle timeout
- Device cookies signed for trusted browser identification
- All API routes validate session cookie (`gp_session` or `gp_admin`)
- 403 returned if session exists but insufficient permissions
- MFA-verified sessions checked for MFA-protected routes
- Next.js form protection (hidden tokens in forms)
- All user data filtered by `gymId` in Prisma queries
- Platform admins can override with explicit `gymId` or operate globally
- Member-scoped operations respect user's gym assignment
